description: Source code implementing various object filtering mechanisms for a Git-like repository, including filters for object types, size limits, depth, sparse checkout, and combination of filters.

classes.name: subfilter
classes.description: Represents a subfilter with seen and omit sets, and skip tree info.

classes.name: filter
classes.description: Defines a filter with function pointers for object filtering, finalization, and cleanup.

classes.name: filter_trees_depth_data
classes.description: Holds data for depth-based tree filtering, including seen trees at various depths.

classes.name: seen_map_entry
classes.description: Represents an entry in the seen map with object ID and depth.

classes.name: filter_blobs_limit_data
classes.description: Stores maximum size in bytes for blob filtering.

classes.name: frame
classes.description: Represents a directory frame in sparse checkout filtering, with default match and child omit flag.

classes.name: filter_sparse_data
classes.description: Holds data for sparse checkout filtering, including pattern list and directory frames.

classes.name: filter_object_type_data
classes.description: Stores object type for filtering specific object types.

classes.name: combine_filter_data
classes.description: Holds subfilters for combined filtering logic.

methods.name: filter_blobs_none
methods.description: Filter that includes all tags, commits, trees; omits blobs.

methods.name: filter_blobs_none__init
methods.description: Initializes the 'none' blob filter.

methods.name: filter_trees_depth
methods.description: Filters trees based on depth, omitting deeper trees.

methods.name: filter_trees_free
methods.description: Frees resources for depth filter data.

methods.name: filter_trees_depth__init
methods.description: Initializes depth-based tree filter.

methods.name: filter_blobs_limit
methods.description: Filters blobs exceeding a size limit.

methods.name: filter_blobs_limit__init
methods.description: Initializes size-limited blob filter.

methods.name: filter_sparse
methods.description: Filters objects based on sparse checkout patterns.

methods.name: filter_sparse_free
methods.description: Frees resources for sparse filter data.

methods.name: filter_sparse_oid__init
methods.description: Initializes sparse checkout filter from a blob OID.

methods.name: filter_object_type
methods.description: Filters objects by specific object type.

methods.name: filter_object_type__init
methods.description: Initializes object type filter.

methods.name: process_subfilter
methods.description: Processes a subfilter for object filtering.

methods.name: filter_combine
methods.description: Combines multiple subfilters with logical AND.

methods.name: filter_combine__free
methods.description: Frees resources for combined filter.

methods.name: filter_combine__finalize_omits
methods.description: Finalizes omit sets for combined filter.

methods.name: filter_combine__init
methods.description: Initializes combined filter with subfilters.

methods.name: list_objects_filter__init
methods.description: Creates a new object filter based on options.

methods.name: list_objects_filter__filter_object
methods.description: Applies the filter to an object.

methods.name: list_objects_filter__free
methods.description: Frees resources for a filter.
